Northfield Housing Association (202298765)

REPORT

COMPLAINT 202298765

Northfield Housing Association

2 February 2023

Our approach

Invented boilerplate, first paragraph.

Invented boilerplate, second paragraph.

The complaint

  1. The complaint is about the association’s handling of a leaking roof and the damp that followed.
  2. The complaint is also about the association’s complaint handling.

Background

  1. The resident is an assured tenant of a house owned by the association.

  2. In autumn 2021 the resident reported water coming through the ceiling.

    She sent photographs of the stained plaster.

Assessment and findings

  1. The association took four months to repair the roof.
  2. It did not explain the delay to the resident.

Determination

  1. In accordance with paragraph 52 of the Scheme, there was maladministration in the association’s handling of the leak and the damp.
  2. In accordance with paragraph 53.b of the Scheme, the association offered reasonable redress for its complaint handling.

Orders

  1. Within 4 weeks the association must:
    1. pay the resident £400 compensation;
    2. apologise to the resident in writing.
  2. The association must send evidence of compliance to the Ombudsman.
